notes.title: Casinopia Update Note (2017.10.24)
notes.notes:
Greetings all,

Today we have an update for the game. We made some improvement and fixed a few bugs.

Update:
- Fixed a bug that caused MENU button stopped working.
- Fixed a bug where you could not close the Gold Shop window.
- Improvements on the game's ease of use/convenience.

Thank you! :)

notes.title: The latest version of graphics card is needed to play the game!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

If you encounter issues during the game, please update your graphics card to the latest version. 

Please follow the step below to update your graphics card:

1. Open [url=https://www.geforce.com/drivers] NVIDIA Website[/url].
2. Click [b]‘Start Search’[/b] on Manual Driver Search section.
3. The result will come up and click the latest version (check the latest release 4. date), and you will go to another page.
5. Click [b]‘Agree & Download’[/b].
6. Install the file after completing the download.
7. Enjoy the game!! ^^

(see the image below for details)

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30760176/2eed88c1f87576e8ed399e05a63f75a60b2b1fde.png[/img]
